name: Kite String
summary: A round download button that stretches into its own progress line while a kite flies along it
about: Kite String starts as a bright round button. Press it and the circle stretches into a thin track, the arrow flies up and becomes a four-colour kite, and the kite rides its string along the filling line with the percent above it. At the end the kite loops and soars away, and the track springs back into a pill that says Saved. Great for download pages and file sharing apps.
how: It squashes, then stretches into a thin track while the arrow flies up and turns into a kite on a string.
The track fills from the left and the kite glides along above the filling edge, showing the percent.
At 100% the kite loops and flies off, the track springs into a Saved pill with confetti, then turns back into a circle.
